_info: Example configuration. Copy to weiche.json and fill in your own data folders and cohort names; weiche.json stays local (git-ignored). Model mapping per task type as measured on 29 Oct 2026 with modellwahl.py.

trivial.beschreibung: short question, lookup, formatting, one-line answer

coding.beschreibung: write, fix or review code or shell scripts

suche.beschreibung: literature or web research, collecting and comparing sources

schwer.beschreibung: planning, analysis, multi-step reasoning, statistics, design decisions

schreiben.beschreibung: write or edit prose: report, wiki entry, mail, document

bild.beschreibung: look at an image, plot or screenshot and judge it
